notes: With WAR_GROUND_PLATES=1 set before launch, grass and shrubs now stay in the ash around raised stone instead of growing through its solid tops. Switching the preview off restores the original cover.

The wanderer can step onto the tested uphill slab lips from an angled approach at both walking and running speed. A step still needs solid ground, room overhead and an earned stride; it cannot climb a taller wall or turn a hillside into a stair.

This remains an opt-in preview. The lift is still abrupt, without a knee lift or weight shift, and the stone still needs weathered edges, debris and its art and performance gates. The ordinary game with the flag unset is unchanged.
title: Raised stone keeps its ground
